items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: Little Crippie Patti. He's good. He's supposed to be in Dallas. He'll be better here for him no more. ... He's a good little drummer.

ctx.x: Ask him about Tony Jackson. He wanted to tell us about Tony Jackson.

So he wanted to tell us about Tony Jackson. Tony Jackson? Well, Tony Jackson, that fellow was a, you know, this cabinet player. He used to play on hold, you know, all the time. He was a piano player. He used to say he was a morphedizer, you know. And the other part of it too, Bunnell. Both of them was good. But then Bunnell used to high sometimes with piano and banjo. Piano and guitar. Like that, you know. In them little, what do you call them, little beer parties, you know. Just two pieces. I played with them…
I asked him, did he know Eddie Vinson?
